curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two ordinary wanderers on the run survive high-stakes espionage when everyone from highway cops to airport operatives thinks they are someone else entirely?
curatedMovie.description: After trucker Doug picks up hitchhiker Rosco, the pair are misidentified as bank robbers by traffic police. Fleeing to the airport to catch a flight, they stumble directly into another mix-up as undercover secret agents.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, fast-paced action comedy with easygoing energy, perfect for relaxed casual viewing with friends.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Enzo Barboni, this breezy action-comedy thrives on fast-moving momentum, cheerful buddy chemistry, and compounding farcical escapes that keep the laughs rolling.
